verdict.rationale: The docs describe one-command installs: `$skill-installer linear` / `$skill-installer gh-address-comments` inside Codex for curated skills. For plugins, they describe the in-agent `/plugins` marketplace browser and `codex plugin marketplace add` for marketplace sources. They also state to start a new session after installing, at which point the bundled skills and tools become available in new chats. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that installs activate reliably in the next session.
